headline: Initial-sync NPE on null bundle metadata + `ca.crt` trailing newline

items.title: Initial sync no longer crashes when the bundle has no metadata yet
items.body: A freshly-enrolled bundle with zero files returned a null `metadata` payload from the server, which the client previously dereferenced unconditionally during the initial-sync diff. The diff now treats the null payload as an empty bundle and proceeds, matching the server's intent.

items.title: Enrolled `ca.crt` written with a trailing newline
items.body: Some TLS stacks (notably the macOS Keychain Access import flow) refuse a PEM file without a trailing newline. The enrollment write path now ensures the file ends with `\n`.
